subject: Commercial & payment gating — pilot routing and vendor onboarding for CloudNova
messages:
From: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@cloudnova.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudnova.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: procurement constraints and next steps

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo today — the team liked the latency profile for the use case. Before we go deeper on legal/pricing, our AP team needs to confirm the path for payments. A few quick items they asked me to clarify:

- Do you accept corporate credit card charges, or do all enterprise customers require a PO and invoicing?
- If you accept card, is there an internal dollar threshold (our AP caps card spend per vendor unless pre-approved)?
- Is Redwood available via AWS Marketplace (we try to prefer Marketplace transacting if possible)?
- What vendor paperwork do you require to get set up (W-9, bank details, SOC2, etc.)?

I attached our AP policy excerpt for context and our vendor W-9 (CloudNova_W9.pdf).

Can you outline two routes (fastest path to get a pilot running, and the standard procurement path)? We’d like to present both to procurement.

Thanks —
Ben Cooper
Sr. Procurement Manager
CloudNova Analytics
[Attachment: CloudNova_W9.pdf]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudnova.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement constraints and next steps

Hi Ben / Tara —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick recap and two viable commercial routes so you can take to AP: 

1) Marketplace (fastest): Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace. If you transact the pilot there using CloudNova’s AWS account and card, we can provision immediately and avoid vendor onboarding. No vendor packet needed for the initial month; AWS handles billing.

2) PO + vendor onboarding (standard): If AP requires a direct vendor relationship, we can onboard CloudNova to Redwood’s finance system and bill on a Net30 invoice with PO number. Typical vendor setup items: W-9, vendor setup form, SOC 2 attestation, bank wiring details, and a point of contact for invoicing. Onboarding usually takes 2–3 weeks depending on AP workload.

Operational notes / tradeoffs:
- Card via Marketplace = fastest, but may introduce a different rate structure and platform fees.
- PO route = cleaner for ongoing enterprise billing and allows consolidated monthly invoices and custom payment terms.
- We can support weekly invoicing during the pilot if AP needs shorter runways (we’ve done weekly for pilots before).

I’m attaching: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (vendor form + instructions) and a draft SOW for the proposed pilot (Redwood_SOW_CloudNova.pdf).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm which path AP prefers (Marketplace card or vendor PO).
- If PO: please share your PO template and the authorized signer for the PO (name + email).
- If Marketplace: confirm AWS account ID used for billing and who will place the order.

Looping in Rishi (pricing) and Monica (onboarding/CS) to help execute whichever route you pick.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0134
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf] [Attachment: Redwood_SOW_CloudNova.pdf]

From: Ben Cooper <ben.cooper@cloudnova.com>

Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudnova.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement constraints and next steps

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear options. A couple clarifications from AP:
- Our policy: corporate card allowed up to $7,000 total per vendor with a head-of-finance approval sequence. Anything >$7k/month requires a PO.
- For pilots, they prefer a PO if the monthly estimate exceeds $5k.
- They’re open to Marketplace for a one-month pilot but want to know whether Redwood can then move to invoiced PO billing after the pilot (no problem switching).
- On invoicing cadence: would you be able to accept weekly invoices for the first 30 days? That would help reconcile usage during the pilot.

I’m attaching the AP excerpt that shows thresholds (AP_Policy.pdf).

We’ll likely propose: Marketplace for immediate start (card) and parallel vendor onboarding to issue a PO for month two. Can you confirm whether Redwood has SOC2 Type II and whether EU data residency is offered for customers needing that? (We have an EU customer that might piggyback on this pilot later.)

Ben
Sr. Procurement Manager
CloudNova Analytics
[Attachment: AP_Policy.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudnova.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement constraints and next steps

Ben / Tara —

All good — short answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II. We can share the attestation under NDA (we typically push the report via our security portal).
- EU data residency: we offer EU-region deployments for customers who require that; for this pilot we can confirm whether CloudNova needs EU-residency now or if it’s only for a downstream customer.
- Weekly invoices: yes, we can accommodate weekly invoicing during an initial pilot period.

Marketplace link for convenience: https://www.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-abcdefg — if you order there, provisioning is automatic and billing sits with AWS. After the first month we can transition to direct PO invoicing; we’ll need a signed SOW and the PO number to close out month 1 / start month 2 terms.

DocuSign: I can send the SOW via DocuSign once you confirm the path.

Rishi — can you confirm the pilot pricing and whether we can extend a one-time 30% pilot discount if CloudNova uses Marketplace for the trial and signs a 6-month commitment afterwards?

Thanks,
Hannah
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the thread — quick commercial proposal to make procurement easy and keep momentum:

2) Parallel PO onboarding: We’ll start vendor setup immediately (W-9 already received). Finance estimates 2–3 business weeks for full vendor activation once the vendor packet is completed. Please send the PO template and authorized signer name/email.

Commercial terms offered:
- Pilot: 30% one-time pilot discount if CloudNova commits to a 6-month term following pilot (contract reference: CLDN-2026-157).
- Billing: We will accommodate weekly invoices during the pilot period if AP prefers.

Action items for CloudNova to unblock:
- Confirm Marketplace order (AWS account ID) OR confirm intent to take the PO route.
- If PO: return the completed vendor packet and PO template + authorized signer.
- If Marketplace: confirm who will place the order and provide the AWS account ID.
